newsitem.title: JAPAN: Uptrend in Japan machinery orders unchanged - EPA.
newsitem.headline: Uptrend in Japan machinery orders unchanged - EPA.

text.p: The basic uptrend in Japan's machinery orders is unchanged despite a month-on-month slip in private machinery orders in February, a senior Economic Planning Agency (EPA) said on Thursday.

The EPA announced on Thursday that private-sector machinery orders, excluding those for machinery at electric power firms and for ships, fell a seasonally adjusted 1.6 percent in February from the previous month to 1.18 trillion yen.

"Private machinery orders showed a marginal drop in February after a double-digit increase in January. But we have not changed our basic view that the overall trend is upward," the official told reporters.
The drop in the machinery orders was mainly due to a month-on-month drop of eight percent in orders from non-manufacturers, he added.
